secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key (Google AI Studio -> API keys). Needed by the Copilot analysis endpoint POST /api/copilot/chat. Optional to boot: without it the server answers with an explicit 'no verified data' message instead of generated figures.

secrets.name: FULGOR_API_KEY
secrets.description: Server-side bearer secret of at least 32 characters (any strong random value). Unlocks the protected /api/v1/* and legacy /api/* endpoints. Optional to boot: without it those endpoints answer 503. Never expose this value to browser code.
